title: GROWTH AND DEVELOPMENT OF HORTICULTURAL CROPS
description: Gain fundamental knowledge of plant growth and development of horticultural crops from a micro- to macro-level starting at double fertilization through fruit growth--covering seed-to-seed. The last section specifically examines how environmental factors affect growth and development.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MWF 12pm-12:50pm in ALS 4000 - Agricultural & Life Sciences B 4000 (9/23 to 12/4)
